---
title: "`r local({ p <- params$meta_rds; if (!is.null(p) && nzchar(p) && file.exists(p)) readRDS(p)$model_name else params$model_name })` -- dynhr Diagnostic Report"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')`"
params:
  diags_rds:         ""
  irfs_rds:          ""
  llm_txt:           ""
  exec_txt:          ""
  meta_rds:          ""
  escape_r:          ""
  plotutil_r:        ""
  model_name:        "model"
  show_explanations: true
format:
  typst:
    toc: true
    toc-depth: 2
    section-numbering: 1.1.a
    papersize: a4
    margin:
      x: 2cm
      y: 2cm
    mainfont: "Source Sans 3"
    sansfont: "Source Sans 3"
    monofont: "JetBrains Mono"
    fontsize: 11pt
    fig-width: 8
    fig-height: 3.4
    fig-dpi: 200
    fig-align: center
    out-width: 100%
    default-image-extension: png
    # Force PNG rendering for ggplots so Typst doesn't have to font-substitute
    # glyphs embedded in SVGs (titles blur when Source Sans 3 is missing).
    fig-format: png
    keep-typ: false
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        // Only the heading colour is static here.  Every level colour (PASS /
        // WARN / FAIL / ERROR / INFO) is emitted per badge from meta$colours
        // (dynhr:::.badge_colour()), so the PDF can never drift from the
        // palette the rest of the package uses.
        #let dynhr-blue = rgb("#0077BB")
        #set text(font: ("Source Sans 3", "Source Sans Pro", "Segoe UI"), size: 11pt)
        #show heading.where(level: 1): set text(fill: dynhr-blue,  font: ("Source Serif 4", "Source Serif Pro", "Georgia"))
        #show heading.where(level: 2): set text(fill: dynhr-blue,  font: ("Source Serif 4", "Source Serif Pro", "Georgia"))
        #show heading.where(level: 3): set text(fill: rgb("#1A1A1A"), font: ("Source Serif 4", "Source Serif Pro", "Georgia"))
        #show link: set text(fill: dynhr-blue)
        #show raw: set text(font: ("JetBrains Mono", "Consolas"), size: 9pt)
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r setup}
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || (is.character(a) && !nzchar(a))) b else a
# Track the chunk default so we can restore it after a per-plot override.
.default_fig_height <- knitr::opts_chunk$get("fig.height") %||% 3.4
# A single diagnostic plot must not monopolise a page: two figures per page is
# the target, so per-plot height requests are capped rather than obeyed.
.max_fig_height <- 9.0   # a page; per-parameter facet plots (68 params -> 74 in requested) get one full page, small plots keep their own height

# Many-panel figures are SPLIT rather than squashed: at NZSIM scale a
# 68-parameter facet plot capped at .max_fig_height gave 0.75 in per facet row
# and a 190-level correlation plot 0.05 in per level.  A4 is much tighter than
# the browser, so these limits are lower than the HTML template's.
.paginate_max_rows <- 5L    # facet rows per page
.paginate_max_y    <- 26L   # discrete y levels per page
diags <- if (nzchar(params$diags_rds %||% "") && file.exists(params$diags_rds)) {
  readRDS(params$diags_rds)
} else NULL
irfs  <- if (nzchar(params$irfs_rds  %||% "") && file.exists(params$irfs_rds)) {
  readRDS(params$irfs_rds)
} else NULL

# report-meta.rds is the ONLY source of classification, ordering, colour,
# explanation and provenance information.  This template used to re-derive the
# badge from $pass / $errored and had no WARN level at all, so a WARN printed
# as a clean PASS; re-deriving anything here is forbidden.
meta <- if (nzchar(params$meta_rds %||% "") && file.exists(params$meta_rds))
  readRDS(params$meta_rds) else NULL
if (is.null(meta) && !is.null(diags))
  stop("report-meta.rds was not supplied (params$meta_rds); ",
       "the template cannot classify diagnostics without it.")

if (nzchar(params$escape_r %||% "") && file.exists(params$escape_r)) {
  source(params$escape_r)
}
if (!exists(".escape_for", inherits = TRUE))
  stop("escape.R was not supplied (params$escape_r); ",
       "the template cannot safely interpolate text without .escape_for().")

# .fig_height_for() / .paginate_plot() are spooled the same way, for the same
# reason.  The template keeps NO copy of the height rule.
if (nzchar(params$plotutil_r %||% "") && file.exists(params$plotutil_r)) {
  source(params$plotutil_r)
}
if (!exists(".fig_height_for", inherits = TRUE) ||
    !exists(".paginate_plot", inherits = TRUE))
  stop("plotutil.R was not supplied (params$plotutil_r); ",
       "the template cannot size or paginate figures without it.")

show_explanations <- isTRUE(params$show_explanations)

.LEVELS  <- c("ERROR", "FAIL", "WARN", "INFO", "PASS")
.CALLOUT <- c(ERROR = "important", FAIL = "important", WARN = "warning",
              INFO  = "note",      PASS = "tip")

diag_items <- if (!is.null(diags))
  Filter(function(r) inherits(r, "dynhr_diagnostic"), diags) else list()
if (length(diag_items) > 0L) {
  ord <- meta$order[meta$order %in% names(diag_items)]
  ord <- c(ord, setdiff(names(diag_items), ord))
  diag_items <- diag_items[ord]
}
diag_badges <- if (length(diag_items) > 0L)
  meta$badges[names(diag_items)] else character(0)
counts <- if (is.null(meta)) stats::setNames(integer(length(.LEVELS)), .LEVELS) else
  meta$counts

.colour <- function(level) {
  cc <- meta$colours[[level]]
  if (is.null(cc) || is.na(cc)) "#BBBBBB" else cc
}

# .diag_meta_for() falls back to the diagnostic's own name when a diagnostic
# has no .DIAG_META row; don't print the name twice in that case.
.disp_id <- function(nm) {
  did <- meta$disp_id[[nm]] %||% ""
  if (identical(did, nm)) "" else did
}

# Colour-coded level badge as raw Typst, so the level's own colour (and not
# the callout type's generic one) is what the reader sees.
.typst_badge <- function(level) {
  sprintf('`#text(fill: rgb("%s"), weight: "bold")[%s]`{=typst}',
          .colour(level), level)
}

.render_summary_block <- function(summary_text) {
  if (is.null(summary_text) || !nzchar(summary_text)) return("")
  lines <- strsplit(summary_text, "\n", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  lines <- lines[nzchar(lines)]
  if (length(lines) <= 1L) return(.escape_for(summary_text, "typst"))
  paste(paste0("- ", .escape_for(lines, "typst")), collapse = "\n")
}

# Plots are written out explicitly rather than print()ed inside the chunk:
# knitr snapshots the figure options at chunk start, so a mid-chunk
# opts_chunk$set() cannot give each plot in a loop its own height or caption.
# Writing the PNG here is also what caps the height (C5 -- a 7.5in request
# used to leave ~60% of every page blank).
.FIG_DIR <- "report-figs"
dir.create(.FIG_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE)

.print_plot <- function(p, nm = NULL, pnm = NULL) {
  if (!inherits(p, "gg")) return(invisible(NULL))
  ## Split a many-panel / many-level figure first; a plot that cannot be
  ## split comes back as a one-element list holding p itself.
  pages <- .paginate_plot(p, max_rows = .paginate_max_rows,
                          max_y = .paginate_max_y,
                          default = .default_fig_height,
                          maximum = .max_fig_height)
  np <- length(pages)
  for (k in seq_len(np)) {
    pk  <- pages[[k]]
    h   <- attr(pk, "dynhr_fig_height", exact = TRUE)
    h   <- if (!is.null(h) && is.finite(h)) as.numeric(h) else
      .fig_height_for(pk, .default_fig_height, .max_fig_height)
    ## Per-parameter facet plots scale their requested height with the number
    ## of estimated parameters (a 68-parameter model asked for 74 in) and a
    ## single figure must not overrun the page.  Cap at .max_fig_height: a
    ## plot that needs more than that is still delivered, just denser.
    h   <- min(h, .max_fig_height)
    ttl <- pk$labels$title %||% (pnm %||% "diagnostic plot")
    cap <- if (is.null(nm)) ttl else sprintf("%s -- %s", nm, ttl)
    key <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "-", paste(c(nm, pnm, ttl), collapse = "-"))
    ## The page index is part of the file key: without it every page of a
    ## split figure would overwrite the previous page's PNG.
    key <- paste0(substr(key, 1L, 80L), if (np > 1L) sprintf("-p%02d", k) else "")
    f   <- file.path(.FIG_DIR, paste0(key, ".png"))
    ggplot2::ggsave(f, pk, width = 8, height = h, dpi = 200, units = "in",
                    limitsize = FALSE)
    cat(sprintf('\n\n![%s](%s){fig-alt="%s" width=100%%}\n\n',
                .escape_for(cap, "typst"), f,
                gsub('"', "'", cap, fixed = TRUE)))
  }
  invisible(NULL)
}

# Methodology text comes from meta$explanations; the template carries no second
# copy of any threshold.
.explanation_block <- function(nm) {
  if (!show_explanations) return(invisible(NULL))
  info <- meta$explanations[[nm]]
  if (is.null(info)) return(invisible(NULL))
  cat(sprintf("**What:** %s\n\n", .escape_for(info$what %||% "", "typst")))
  cat(sprintf("**What to look for:** %s\n\n",
              .escape_for(info$look_for %||% "", "typst")))
  cat(sprintf("*Reference:* %s\n\n",
              .escape_for(info$citation %||% "", "typst")))
  invisible(NULL)
}

.diag_block <- function(nm) {
  r     <- diag_items[[nm]]
  level <- unname(diag_badges[[nm]])
  did   <- .disp_id(nm)
  cat(sprintf("\n## %s%s -- %s\n\n", .escape_for(nm, "typst"),
              if (nzchar(did)) paste0(" -- ", .escape_for(did, "typst")) else "",
              level))
  cat(sprintf("::: {.callout-%s}\n%s\n\n", .CALLOUT[[level]], .typst_badge(level)))
  cat(.render_summary_block(r$summary %||% ""), "\n\n", sep = "")
  act <- meta$actions[[nm]] %||% ""
  if (nzchar(act))
    cat(sprintf("**Action:** %s\n\n", .escape_for(act, "typst")))
  .explanation_block(nm)
  cat(":::\n\n")
  for (pnm in names(r$plots)) .print_plot(r$plots[[pnm]], nm, pnm)
  invisible(NULL)
}
```

# Executive Summary

```{r exec-summary}
#| results: asis
# Pre-rendered by write_report(); a fenced code block keeps the scorecard's
# fixed-width alignment and needs no escaping.
exec_lines <- if (nzchar(params$exec_txt %||% "") && file.exists(params$exec_txt))
  readLines(params$exec_txt, warn = FALSE) else NULL
if (!is.null(exec_lines)) {
  cat("````\n")
  cat(paste(exec_lines, collapse = "\n"))
  cat("\n````\n")
} else {
  cat("> No diagnostic suite loaded (diags_rds not supplied).\n")
}
```

# Provenance

```{r provenance}
#| results: asis
# A diagnostic report is a claim about a specific model, at a specific commit,
# against specific data: state that before 30 pages of plots, not after.
prov_labels <- c(dynhr_version = "dynhr version", git_commit = "Git commit",
                 model_name = "Model", model_file = "Model file",
                 n_obs = "Observations", obs_vars = "Observables",
                 data_hash = "Data hash", sample_span = "Sample span",
                 seed = "Seed", sampler = "Sampler", n_draws = "Draws",
                 n_warmup = "Warmup", n_chains = "Chains",
                 rendered_at = "Rendered at")
prov <- meta$provenance %||% list()
cat("| Item | Value |\n|:-----|:------|\n")
for (k in names(prov_labels)) {
  v <- prov[[k]]
  txt <- if (is.null(v) || length(v) == 0L || all(is.na(v)))
    "not recorded" else paste(as.character(v), collapse = ", ")
  cat(sprintf("| %s | %s |\n", .escape_for(prov_labels[[k]], "md_table"),
              .escape_for(txt, "md_table")))
}
cat("\n")
```

# Summary

```{r summary-line}
#| results: asis
cat(sprintf("**%d PASS | %d WARN | %d FAIL | %d ERROR | %d INFO** -- %d diagnostics\n\n",
            counts[["PASS"]], counts[["WARN"]], counts[["FAIL"]],
            counts[["ERROR"]], counts[["INFO"]], length(diag_items)))
cat(.escape_for(meta$legend %||% "", "typst"), "\n\n", sep = "")
if (length(diag_items) > 0) {
  cat("| ID | Status | Summary |\n")
  cat("|:---|:------:|:--------|\n")
  for (nm in names(diag_items)) {
    r <- diag_items[[nm]]
    # Escape FIRST (which also flattens newlines to "; "), then truncate, so a
    # cut can never split an escape sequence or re-open a pipe.
    s <- .escape_for(r$summary %||% "", "md_table")
    if (nchar(s) > 110) s <- paste0(substr(s, 1, 107), "...")
    cat(sprintf("| `%s` | %s | %s |\n", .escape_for(nm, "md_table"),
                unname(diag_badges[[nm]]), s))
  }
  cat("\n")
}
```

```{r diag-sections}
#| results: asis
# Same severity sections as the HTML report, so the two formats read against
# each other: ERROR (did not run) before FAIL (ran and failed), PASS last.
present <- .LEVELS[vapply(.LEVELS, function(lv) any(diag_badges == lv), logical(1))]
if (length(present) == 0L) {
  cat("\n# Diagnostic details\n\n*No diagnostics to report.*\n\n")
} else {
  for (lv in present) {
    cat(sprintf("\n# %s (%d)\n\n", lv, sum(diag_badges == lv)))
    for (nm in names(diag_items)[diag_badges == lv]) .diag_block(nm)
  }
}
```

# Impulse responses

```{r irfs-static}
#| results: asis
if (is.null(irfs) || length(irfs) == 0L) {
  cat("\n*No IRFs were supplied to `write_report()`.*\n\n")
} else {
  horizons <- vapply(irfs, function(p) {
    d <- if (inherits(p, "gg")) p$data else NULL
    if (is.null(d) || is.null(d$horizon)) NA_integer_ else as.integer(max(d$horizon))
  }, integer(1))
  cat(sprintf("Units: %s\n\n", .escape_for(meta$irf_units %||% "", "typst")))
  if (length(unique(horizons[!is.na(horizons)])) > 1L)
    cat(sprintf("Horizons differ across shocks (%s periods); the x-ranges below are not comparable.\n\n",
                .escape_for(paste(sort(unique(horizons[!is.na(horizons)])),
                                  collapse = ", "), "typst")))
  for (shock_nm in names(irfs)) {
    cat(sprintf("\n## Shock: %s\n\n", .escape_for(shock_nm, "typst")))
    p <- irfs[[shock_nm]]
    if (!inherits(p, "gg")) next
    # The section heading already names the shock: drop the duplicated plot
    # title, keeping it as the figure caption.
    ttl <- p$labels$title %||% shock_nm
    p2  <- p + ggplot2::labs(title = NULL)
    attr(p2, "dynhr_fig_height") <- attr(p, "dynhr_fig_height", exact = TRUE)
    .print_plot(p2, NULL, ttl)
  }
}
```
